name: llama.cpp
sycl_backend_coverage: ~65% of CUDA ops covered (20 of 32 scan-identified kernel groups; many more via oneDNN gemm and element_wise unification)

sycl_tla.notes: Set enabled=true and resolve include (from config targets.sycl_tla) when a kernel targets sycl-tla.

reference.notes: CPU reference: llama.cpp already has CPU (ggml) backend for all ops. Use the CPU-backend output as the reference oracle for accuracy validation.

notes: Existing SYCL backend at ggml/src/ggml-sycl/ confirmed (~36K lines, 51 source files, built successfully on B70). Covers ~90% of CUDA ops via oneDNN/oneMKL/element_wise/gemm. Only 13 kernels (9 logical ops) truly missing: allreduce, dsv4-hc, fwht, ggml-cuda-infra, lightning-indexer, opt-step-adamw, opt-step-sgd, snake, softcap.
